entries.title: Choose models by level in Settings
entries.body: Settings lets you choose models by level, and drag them into the order you want.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Task status reads the same everywhere
entries.body: Every view of a task now shares one set of facts, so status no longer differs between the board and the crew summary.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Claude usage recovers when you change the saved login
entries.body: A spent-allowance hold and a declined usage read clear once the saved Claude login changes.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: the usage reading simply comes back.

entries.title: Cloning a project offers the sign-in way again
entries.body: The clone flow shows how to sign in through the shared actions.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Card threads no longer repeat the author, model and close
entries.body: The thread head drops the repeat of what the card already shows.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: Links to localhost subdomains open safely
entries.body: HTTP links to subdomains of localhost open through the same safe check as other links.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the link opens through the same safe check.

entries.title: A cancelled duplicate check no longer decides a pull request
entries.body: A later run of the same check now decides the result.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the later check now decides the result.

entries.title: Custom providers finish long streamed replies
entries.body: Turns on a custom API provider no longer stop before a long streamed reply ends.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: a long reply now simply finishes.

entries.title: Abandoned attempts close their pull requests
entries.body: When a crewmate abandons an attempt, its open pull request is closed.
entries.noPicture: The change happens on GitHub, not in the app.

entries.title: A cancelled decision stops its model request
entries.body: A cancel now stops the decision model's request, and replies past 64 KB are refused.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: a cancel now stops the work behind it.

entries.title: The Firstmate starts each turn with leaner instructions
entries.body: The fixed instructions and tool list are trimmed.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: Firstmate's own instructions are shorter.

entries.title: Model library upgraded to Pi 1.0
entries.body: The app now runs on Pi 1.0.

entries.title: Read a closed card again
entries.body: A closed card can be reopened from the stage as a read-only past card.

picture.alt: A closed plan brought back on the stage as a past card, with the choice you made marked and nothing on it to click

entries.title: Replies under a finished task's kept note reach that note's thread
entries.body: A reply under a note kept after its task finished is answered in the same thread.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

entries.title: The Tasks filter finds earlier closed and dropped work
entries.body: Searching Tasks now includes work that was closed or dropped earlier.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.

exclusions.reason: Test, end-to-end and documentation changes with no effect on the shipped app, reviewed when the notes ledger began.
